name: @mars/claude-session
description: Standalone library for programmatically controlling interactive Claude sessions.
//node-pty: NATIVE DEP STRATEGY: prebuilt-binary path (option a). node-pty v1.1.0 ships prebuilts for darwin-arm64/x64, win32-arm64/x64. postinstall chmods spawn-helper so the prebuilt works on macOS/Linux. Fallback source build needs python3 + C++ toolchain + node-gyp. See README.
//prepare: Intentionally NO `prepare` script. The orchestrator's worktree-install step runs `npm ci` in this package in parallel with every other install site and caps each at 8 minutes (DEFAULT_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_MS). A `prepare`-triggered tsup build with `dts: true` adds ~5s of TSC work to every install, which under concurrent setup load has caused SIGTERM kills (see recovery task for worktree 6015eb45). `dist/` is rebuilt explicitly via `npm run build` when a consumer needs it; `prepublishOnly` covers publishes. Mirrors the lifecycle-build opt-out already in place for @mars/workflow (commit dd49c34).
